_about: How each affiliate product is shown on the landing page, keyed by scripts.py affiliate.product_name. name = what a shopper recognizes, slug = the permanent #pick-<slug> anchor (quickbyteshorts.pages.dev/#pick-<slug> jumps straight to the card, so never rename one that's live), note = one plain sentence on why (written like you'd text a friend, no hype), budget = 25 / 50 / 100 / 999 for the gift sections (the typical price when picked; no prices are ever shown, because Amazon only allows prices pulled live from its API), gift = belongs in the holiday gift picks. photo = a hand-picked Pexels image (free for commercial use) that actually shows the product category; checked by eye, since automatic stock matches were often wrong. Never use Amazon's product images.

30W USB-C PD GaN charger.name: Anker Nano 30W USB-C charger
30W USB-C PD GaN charger.note: Most phones don't come with a charger anymore, and this one is pocket-sized but fast enough for a phone or an iPad.

Tile Mate bluetooth tracker.name: Tile Mate tracker
Tile Mate bluetooth tracker.note: Works with iPhone and Android, so it's the safe tracker gift when you don't know what phone they have.

240W USB-C cable with e-marker (USB4 40G.name: UGREEN 240W USB-C cable (USB4)
240W USB-C cable with e-marker (USB4 40G.note: One cable that handles full-speed data, 4K video and laptop charging, so nobody has to guess which cable is which.

microfiber cleaning cloths for screens.name: MagicFiber microfiber cloths (6-pack)
microfiber cleaning cloths for screens.note: The only thing that should touch a screen. Cheap, washable, and a solid stocking stuffer.

USB-C power bank with PD fast charging.name: Anker Nano power bank (10,000mAh)
USB-C power bank with PD fast charging.note: Built-in USB-C cable and 30W output, so it actually fast-charges a phone instead of trickling.

budget mechanical keyboard.name: Redragon K552 mechanical keyboard
budget mechanical keyboard.note: A compact, sturdy mechanical board for a fraction of the big-name price. Great first keyboard for a teen or a new desk setup.

smart speaker.name: Echo Pop or Nest Mini
smart speaker.note: Small, cheap and genuinely useful for music, timers and lights. Pick the one that matches the phone they use.

4K streaming stick.name: 4K streaming stick
4K streaming stick.note: The cheapest way to make an older or slow smart TV feel new. Roku, Fire TV and Google TV all have the big apps.

Qi2 magnetic wireless charger.name: Belkin Qi2 magnetic charger
Qi2 magnetic wireless charger.note: Snaps into place so the phone charges at full speed instead of running warm on a misaligned pad.

noise cancelling wireless earbuds.name: Soundcore Liberty 4 NC earbuds
noise cancelling wireless earbuds.note: Strong noise cancelling for well under flagship prices. The included ear tips matter more than the brand.

WiFi digital photo frame.name: Wi-Fi photo frame
WiFi digital photo frame.note: The family sends photos from their phones and they just appear. Pick one that doesn't require a subscription.

Kindle e-reader.name: Kindle Paperwhite
Kindle e-reader.note: Paper-like screen, weeks of battery and nothing pinging them mid-chapter. In the US it borrows library books through Libby.

2.5 inch SATA SSD 500GB.name: Samsung 870 EVO SSD (500GB)
2.5 inch SATA SSD 500GB.note: The upgrade that makes an old laptop boot in seconds instead of minutes. Check that your laptop takes a 2.5-inch drive first.

Kodak Step instant photo printer (Zink).name: Kodak Step mini photo printer
Kodak Step instant photo printer (Zink).note: Prints 2x3 sticky-back photos straight from a phone with no ink to buy, which teens use for journals and lockers.

instant-read meat thermometer.name: ThermoPro TP19H instant-read thermometer
instant-read meat thermometer.note: Reads in a few seconds and has a backlit screen, so you stop guessing whether the chicken is done.

conical burr coffee grinder.name: Baratza Encore burr grinder
conical burr coffee grinder.note: Grinds every bean to the same size, which does more for the taste of your coffee than a new coffee maker.

5-quart basket air fryer.name: Cosori Pro LE 5-quart air fryer
5-quart basket air fryer.note: Five quarts is enough to cook a single layer of fries or wings for a family of four.

variable temperature electric kettle.name: Variable-temperature gooseneck kettle
variable temperature electric kettle.note: Worth it for tea and pour-over people, since green tea wants water well under boiling. Everyone else is fine with a basic kettle.

digital kitchen scale.name: Digital kitchen scale
digital kitchen scale.note: Weighing flour instead of scooping it is the easiest way to make a recipe come out the same every time.

27 inch 1440p monitor.name: 27-inch 1440p monitor
27 inch 1440p monitor.note: At 27 inches, 1440p keeps text sharp where 1080p starts to look soft.

1080p mini projector with Google TV.name: 1080p mini projector with Google TV
1080p mini projector with Google TV.note: Built-in Google TV means Netflix and the other apps just work, which a lot of cheap projectors can't promise.

65W 2-port USB-C GaN charger.name: 65W two-port USB-C charger
65W 2-port USB-C GaN charger.note: One small brick can charge a USB-C laptop and a phone at the same time, so you pack one charger instead of three.

8-quart dual-basket air fryer.name: Dual-basket air fryer (8 qt)
8-quart dual-basket air fryer.note: Two 4-quart baskets mean the chicken and the fries finish at the same time, which a single basket can't do.

leave-in probe meat thermometer.name: Leave-in probe meat thermometer
leave-in probe meat thermometer.note: It stays in the turkey and beeps when it's close, so you're not opening the oven every ten minutes.

5-speed hand mixer.name: 5-speed hand mixer
5-speed hand mixer.note: Handles cookie dough, whipped cream and cake batter, and it goes back in a drawer when you're done.

IP67 clip-on Bluetooth speaker.name: IP67 clip-on Bluetooth speaker
IP67 clip-on Bluetooth speaker.note: IP67 means it can handle the beach, the shower and a dropped drink, and the clip hangs it off a bag.

lidar robot vacuum.name: Robot vacuum with lidar
lidar robot vacuum.note: The spinning lidar turret maps your rooms, so it cleans in rows instead of bumping around and missing spots.

Qi2 3-in-1 charging stand with Apple Wat.name: Qi2 3-in-1 stand with Apple Watch charger
Qi2 3-in-1 charging stand with Apple Wat.note: Charges an iPhone, AirPods and an Apple Watch overnight, because the watch gets its own puck instead of a flat pad.
